# A two-way prop the call site binds, read through the node's `#id`, reads
# what it is bound to: `t.selected` under `:selected=sel` is `sel` (propHolds
# on the targets, readThroughHandle in the interpreter). A handler reads the
# value its report wrote, which the interpreter read off the handle as the
# node last rendered it. A table under two loops, reached from the test
# through the text that reads it, is the shape that first broke on bubbletea.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok +3 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok +3 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +3 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +3 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +3 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok +3 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component grid(cells list[string]) ui.node {
    var sel = 0

    ui.table #t(columns=["name"], selectable=true, :selected=sel) {
        for var c = cells {
            if c != "" {
                ui.tableRow(cells=[c])
            }
        }
    }
    ui.text #shown(value="{t.selected}")
    ui.button #last(text="last", @click { sel = cells.length() - 1 })
}

component groups ui.node {
    var outer = [[["a", "b"], ["c"]], [["d", "e", "f"]]]

    for var i, gs = outer {
        for var g = gs {
            ui.text #title(value="{i}")
            grid #grid(cells=g)
        }
    }
    ui.button #add(text="add", @click { outer.push([["g"]]) })
}

component fields ui.node {
    var name = "ada"
    var on = false
    var heard = "none"
    var typed = "none"

    ui.input #f(:value=name, @input { typed = f.value })
    ui.checkbox #box(label="on", :checked=on, @change { heard = "{box.checked}" })
    ui.text #seen(value="{f.value} {box.checked}")
    ui.text #handled(value="{heard} {typed}")
    ui.button #set(text="set", @click {
        name = "grace"
        on = true
    })
}

func testEachCopyReadsItsOwnSelection(t test.Test, c groups) {
    t.assert(c.grid[0][0].shown.value == "0")
    c.grid[1][0].last.click()
    t.assert(c.grid[1][0].shown.value == "2")
    t.assert(c.grid[0][0].shown.value == "0")
    c.add.click()
    t.assert(c.title[2][0].value == "2")
}

func testABoundPropReadsWhatItIsBoundTo(t test.Test, c fields) {
    t.assert(c.seen.value == "ada false")
    c.set.click()
    t.assert(c.seen.value == "grace true")
}

func testAHandlerReadsTheValueReported(t test.Test, c fields) {
    c.box.change(true)
    c.f.input("bee")
    t.assert(c.handled.value == "true bee")
}
